steps.description:
Show that you can create a function named beepingSound and do the following:
1. Play a beeping sound of 5 beeps with an interval of 1 second.

Show that your robot can call your function beepingSound

Show that you can create a function named displayAndBeep and do the following:
1. Display "Hello" on the LCD 

2. Play a beeping sound for 5 beeps with an interval of 1 second

3. When the beeping sound is done, clear LCD screen

Show that your robot can call your function displayAndBeep

Show that you can create two functions:
Create a function named beepingSound
1. Play a beeping sound of 5 beeps with an interval of 1 second

Create a function displayAndBeep
1. Display "Hello" on the LCD
2. Play a beeping sound for 5 beeps with an interval of 1 second
3. When the beeping sound is done, clear LCD Screen

Show that your robot can do the following:
1. Play beeping sound

2. Perform a beeping sound and display "Hello"
